WHAT WE DO / INTERIOR DESIGN

Your identity.
In every detail.

Bring layout, light, colour and materials together around the way your workplace needs to feel and function.

Let’s talk about your space ↗
THE CONVERSATION

Start with what
your space needs.

Scope, deliverables and availability are discussed for each brief.

01

Set a visual direction

Use a small set of references and a material palette to connect the space with your brand. Discuss what is functional, what is expressive and where the two meet.

02

Design the everyday experience

Consider lighting, acoustics, seating, privacy and the route through the office. Look beyond a single hero view to the places people use throughout the day.

03

Resolve the specifications

Review samples, dimensions and maintenance needs before finalising finishes. Record decisions so that procurement and delivery have a shared reference.

COME PREPARED

A useful first conversation.

✓ A floor plan or approximate area

✓ Team size and working patterns

✓ Your priorities and non-negotiables

✓ A budget range and desired move date
